composer.title: Your thesis. The assets that match it.
composer.intro: Convinced AI or Ethereum will reshape entire industries? Turn that conviction into a screened list of public and pre-IPO stocks, ETFs, crypto and Polymarket bets.
composer.input.label: Investment thesis
composer.input.placeholder: Add a thesis, an article, a link, a note or a voice recording. SyntheTick reads the investment case and your constraints, screens the market and checks every result against your criteria.

section.thesis.info: SyntheTick reads your input and builds this card: a summary of the thesis, its key themes ranked by search priority, and the screen settings. Everything here is editable, and it is what steers the screen.
section.progress.info: The screen runs in steps: apply your criteria, search the eligible universe, rank candidates by thesis fit, check every constraint, then load market data. Follow each step live here.
section.results.info: The assets that passed every check, ranked by thesis fit on an absolute 0 to 100 scale. Each card shows market data and 30 day price history where they can be shown, risks and trading venues, plus a downloadable report. Recent news is coming soon.
review.thesis.hint: A plain-language summary of your thesis. Edit it to change what the screen looks for.
review.themes.ranked: Key themes. Ranked by search priority.
review.themes.editing: Key themes. Remove or reorder to change search priority.
review.themes.hint: The sub ideas of your thesis. Order sets which ones are searched first.
review.themes.none: No themes selected. The thesis summary will drive the screen.
review.themes.others: Other themes. Included at lower priority.
review.private: Referenced entities that are not available as investments
review.private.note: These entities are private or outside the current universe. The screen will look for listed exposure through the themes above.
review.settings.hint: Direction, breadth, assets, markets and size. These filters shape which assets the screen returns.
review.direction.hint: Long buys the theme, Short bets against it, Both screens each side.
review.breadth.hint: Focused keeps the strongest matches. Diversified spreads results across themes.
review.assets.hint: Which asset classes to include. All screens the full universe.
review.markets.hint: Which stock markets to screen. Crypto is always global.
review.cap.hint: Company size band. Does not apply to ETFs or bonds.
review.action.runNote: The first screen runs automatically. You will be able to edit the investment thesis and run it again.
finreq.hint: Read from your request and applied as hard filters. Remove one to widen the screen.
finreq.notApplied: Not applied, because we do not hold this data: {items}. These are left to the thesis match.
results.recap.long: {companies} companies across {listings} tradable listings. Ranked by thesis fit. Every result met the selected criteria.
results.recap.short: {companies} companies across {listings} tradable listings. Ranked by short fit. Every result met the selected criteria.
results.prices: Prices and 30 day history come from market data providers.
results.both.recap: {longs} long companies and {shorts} short candidates across {listings} tradable listings. Every result met the selected criteria.
results.strategies.recap: {companies} companies across {listings} tradable listings. Results cover {count} distinct strategies and are ranked on the same fit scale.
results.empty.text: No asset met every requirement. Widen one or more filters to run a broader screen.
results.pm.recap.one: {count} live Polymarket contract tied to the thesis outcome. Prices are current market implied probabilities.
results.pm.recap.other: {count} live Polymarket contracts tied to the thesis outcome. Prices are current market implied probabilities.
results.pm.none.text: No live Polymarket contract is closely tied to this thesis. A more specific event or outcome may produce better results.
results.report.text: Download the sources, thesis, criteria and results as a PDF.
results.edit.text: Return to the review card and run an updated screen.
results.edit.ask: Want to download this list as a report?
results.edit.ask.text: Save the current list before editing, or continue without a PDF.
results.footer: This is a research starting point, not a recommendation. SyntheTick does not assess valuation, timing or suitability.
results.footer.short: Short positions can produce unlimited losses and may involve borrow costs or short squeezes. This research does not model those risks.
results.footer.prices: Prices come from external market data providers and include an as of time when available.
